rows: Preparation phase; no party has yet been approached
Agreed in the engagement letter; the working list is with the company for approval
Closed deals of similar size and type; the basis for our valuation range

blocks.text: The list is short on purpose. Every party on it has a plain reason to want a business of this kind, and none will learn the company's name before signing a non-disclosure agreement. The comparable transactions frame the range. They do not set the price. Buyers will study the same deals and argue from them, so we want Laura Gonzalez and the owners to hear our reading first. Rachel Brown has tied each figure in the draft memorandum back to the model, and the rebuilt projections now stand on the same footing as the historical statements. The reference set leans on recent deals, and we have left out transactions where a buyer paid for a strategic fit this company does not offer. Nothing in the preparation so far has moved us off the range Mark Allen took the owners through last month.

items: Customer concentration: contract terms and revenue history for the larger accounts.
